bounds.domain: Two evidence pages. Each page is bought at most once. The job stays live while a page is still pending.
assumptions: Weak fairness assumes an enabled success or non-retryable failure of the selected page eventually runs. No wall-clock deadline is proved. A retryable provider error, a changed evidence revision, and a third page are outside this instance.
The blocked page is the page that just stopped. The other page is different input. The implementation records that block on the task before the scheduler runs the job again.
The failed page stays uncommitted in the journal. A later job with a new evidence id may select it. This model does not include that later job.
